# ComplianceOS

> vCFO automation for Indian company incorporation and ongoing statutory compliance.

ComplianceOS helps virtual CFO firms and their clients track pre-incorporation, post-incorporation, FEMA, and statutory compliance items end-to-end.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): KPIs and upcoming deadlines across all clients.
- [Onboarding](/onboarding): 5-step wizard to create a new client and generate their compliance checklist.
- [Incorporation Tracker](/incorporation): Pre-inc stepper, post-inc cards, and FEMA FCGPR log.
- [Documents](/documents): Central hub for all required documents.
- [Statutory Compliance](/compliance): GST, PT, IEC, LUT, LEI, S&E and more.
- [Timeline](/timeline): Master timeline of every deadline.
